description: Defines a template class 'LinkType' within the 'Thunder::Core' namespace, implementing a generic link/channel with serialization/deserialization, handling data transmission, state changes, and external interactions.

classes.name: LinkType
classes.description: A template class representing a generic communication link with serialization, deserialization, and state management.

classes.name: SerializerImpl
classes.description: Handles serialization of outbound messages with thread safety and queue management.

classes.name: DeserializerImpl
classes.description: Handles deserialization of inbound messages with resource pooling.

classes.name: HandlerType
classes.description: A wrapper for link handlers to manage data transfer and state signaling.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Returns a reference to the underlying link channel.

methods.name: RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier of the link.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Virtual method to handle incoming requests.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Virtual method to handle outgoing responses.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Virtual method to handle changes in channel state.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits an outbound message into the channel if open.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the channel with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the channel with a specified wait time.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the channel is open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the channel is closed.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if the channel has encountered an error.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Serializes data to be sent over the channel.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Deserializes received data from the channel.
